features.description: New leaf package internal/fileguard wrapping os.Root; EffContext carries one shared root handle (opened once per sandbox path, copied by WithBudget/Clone, closed by the owner via CloseFSRoot); all 23 registered FS ops (read/readBytes/write/writeBytes/append/appendBytes/exists/listDir/mkdir/mkdirAll/isDir/isFile/removeFile/renameFile + the 8 Result variants) dispatch to the root when Env.Sandbox is set and to os.* otherwise. Absolute paths lexically inside the root become relative names; final authorization is always the root-handle operation. Boolean probes return false + logSandboxReject on escape, Result ops return Err, error ops return an error; a rejected op has no outside side effect. GOOS=js refuses a sandbox instead of a lexical fallback. Red-first: fs_containment_test.go (F1 ../marker.txt, F2 link.txt) must FAIL on baseline before fs.go is touched; transcript in the commit body.
acceptance_criteria: TestFSContainment_Traversal and TestFSContainment_Symlink fail on the audited baseline (transcript recorded) and pass after; the random sentinel never appears in any result
A table-driven containment test iterates every FS op name in effects.Registry["FS"] so an op with no containment row fails the test
Valid in-root relative symlinks keep working; absolute symlinks (even pointing back inside) are denied and the CHANGELOG names that migration
Rename is tested with BOTH operands escaping under a set Sandbox (the existing TestFSRenameFile_DirectoryWithinSandbox never set Sandbox)
removeDirResult on a symlink-to-directory is Err (entry not dereferenced); non-empty dir still Err; empty dir Ok
Concurrent symlink-swap test under -race never reads/modifies the outside sentinel; CloseFSRoot is idempotent and a descriptor-count check shows no leak
TestFSSandbox_AbsolutePathWithinSandbox, TestSandboxReject_*, TestFS_RemoveDirResult_EmptyOnly unchanged and green; make test-core, make lint, make check-boundaries green
features.notes: fileguard leaf package over os.Root; EffContext shared root holder (WithBudget/Clone share, owner CloseFSRoot in runner/batch); all 23 FS ops + pkgAssetPath on the backend seam; archive builtins (zip/gzip/tar/zip_xml) routed through EffContext.FS*. Red-first: 118 containment rows + swap race failed on baseline; archive test mutation-tested (15 rows red on old files). effects/builtins/fileguard/runner/embed/cmd/ailang/server suites green; make lint + check-boundaries green.

features.description: One destination authorizer (net_authorize.go) built from NetContext or StreamContext: scheme, non-empty host, no userinfo, one domain-allowlist implementation (lowercase + trailing-dot normalisation, label-boundary wildcard), resolve-with-context + validate every candidate + pinned dial. netProxyRoundTripper.RoundTrip authorizes the URL BEFORE proxy/direct selection so every redirect hop is authorized before any dial; validateRedirect authorizes too; cross-origin redirects strip Authorization/Cookie/Proxy-Authorization in all four HTTP entrypoints. SSE GET/POST and NDJSON POST use a stream round tripper sharing the authorizer + pinned dial with CheckRedirect. StreamDialConfig gains DialContext + Authorize; streamws uses cfg.DialContext as NetDialContext (no independent re-resolution). NetContext.RefuseProxy for restricted mode: named error, no direct fallback. Red-first: net_redirect_containment_test.go (N1) fails on baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Redirect-to-denied-host tests for httpGet, httpRequest, sseConnect and ndjsonPost FAIL on baseline (transcript recorded: /final reached, error nil) and pass after; the recording handler proves /final is never hit

Table test per entrypoint: allowed host, denied host, redirect to denied, resolved private IP, IPv4/IPv6/mapped-IPv4 literal, GoCtx cancellation, TLS SNI == original hostname against httptest.NewTLSServer
isStreamAllowedDomain and matchDomain collapse to one implementation; *.example.com does not match evil-example.com or example.com
streamws test proves the transport dials only through cfg.DialContext (counter on the injected dialer) and never calls net.LookupIP itself
RefuseProxy test: a configured proxy under restricted mode yields a named error and zero dials
All existing net_proxy_test.go / net_test.go / stream_*_test.go contracts green; go test -race ./internal/effects ./internal/platform/streamws green

features.description: internal/policy: security_mode (restricted default | trusted_host), Resolve() into an immutable policy.Resolved (mode, root, effects, net grants, budgets, Timeout, MaxSourceBytes, entry, output caps) validating timeout_ms > 0, restricted mode admitting only IO/FS/Net/Clock/Rand/Stream (Stream process-source ops denied), ailang_only agents refusing trusted_host (internal/executor/agent_policy.go). policy.Check tests row.Tail BEFORE the empty-label shortcut. cmd/ailang/run_policy.go refuses --entry/--env/--env-snapshot/--net-allow-localhost/--net-allow-metadata/--stream-allow-*/--stdlib-path/--package-dir by name, pins the entry from the policy, derives Stream domains from net_allow, sets RefuseProxy in restricted mode, reads the source ONCE under max_source_bytes and admits + executes the same bytes. Supervisor: parent re-execs the binary with an internal --policy-worker flag; child writes the admission decision on a dedicated control pipe (fd 3, JSON lines), stdout/stderr stay data; parent enforces timeout_ms from before source load with exec.CommandContext + proctree group kill, caps combined output (stop reading at the cap and kill), sanitises the worker env to an allowlist, and emits a versioned envelope {version:1, stage, effect, policy_digest, reason}. Windows restricted mode is a named startup refusal.
acceptance_criteria: TestCheck_OpenEmptyRowDenied fails on baseline and passes after; a compiler-generated open-row fixture is added if reachable, else the direct row test is the evidence and the notes say so

TestRunPolicy_TimeoutMsEnforced: an infinite-loop program with timeout_ms = 200 terminates within 2s with envelope.reason == timeout; a trusted_host grandchild (sleep 30) is dead within 2s of return (bounded ESRCH poll)
TestRunPolicy_RefusesWideningFlags covers every newly refused flag by name; --entry is refused and the policy's entry is what runs

TestResolve_*: restricted refuses Process/Env/Secret/AI/SharedCache with a named message; trusted_host keeps Process; ailang_only + trusted_host is refused at the executor; timeout_ms 0/negative refused

Mutating the .ail file between admission and execution does not change what runs (test writes a second program over the file from a goroutine after the policy line appears, or the worker is fed the captured bytes) — decisions come only from the control pipe, a program printing a fake 'policy: {...}' line on stdout is not believed
Existing TestRunPolicy_* green; make test-core, make lint green

features.description:
OperatorBudget (budget_operator.go): mutex-guarded per-effect ceilings charged once at the canonical charge scope before the frame charge, shared by pointer across WithBudget/Clone, untouched by --no-budgets; explicit 0 = zero ops, absent = unlimited; run_policy installs it instead of refusing [budgets]. New leaf package internal/policytool: typed dispatch table {read, write, edit, check, fmt, iface, test, docs_search, examples, builtins, summary} backed by policy.Resolved + fileguard; read/write/edit root-anchored, edit keeps the exact-once expected-content contract; CLI ops build argv from validated in-root relative paths only. `ailang policy-tool --policy

` = JSON request on stdin, JSON response on stdout. .pi/extensions/ailang-exec.ts drops fsSandboxOf/policySummary/cliDecision regex+heuristics for the Go summary; ailang_cli forwards typed requests; ailang_read/ailang_write/ailang_edit tools registered with pi's canonical parameter names; executor.ProfileTools(ailang_only) replaces native Read/Write/Edit with AilangRead/AilangWrite/AilangEdit; canonicalToPi maps them; make pi-assets regenerates the embedded copies.
acceptance_criteria: TestOperatorBudget_ExactlyN: budget N permits exactly N charged ops across nested functions, an imported module and repeated WithBudget scopes, then denies BEFORE the side effect; a source @limit larger than N cannot raise it; explicit 0 denies the first op; go test -race on a concurrent Stream charge test green

TestToolArgs_AilangOnlyProfile asserts the exact pi --tools list contains ailang_read,ailang_write,ailang_edit and NOT read,write,edit
Extension unit tests (.pi) pass with the Go-produced summary; make verify-pi-assets green
A policy declaring [budgets] no longer refuses at run_policy; the banked policy: line lists the enforced budgets
